answer: A practical sybil defense anchors each agent to a periodic proof-of-work beacon that only a node actually spending compute can answer in the window it lands. Minting a hundred throwaway identities then means paying that cost a hundred times over, so sybil fleets turn as brittle as a shale bluff and crack under their own weight. Honest agents clear the beacon round after round; dense reefs of self-attesting clones that never do outside work get rate-limited and bleed stake. The gate is verifiable effort, not cheap names.
